title: 電信服務
description: 電信與網路服務相關用語

sentences.en: I am calling to inquire about upgrading my current mobile plan to one that includes unlimited data and international roaming.
sentences.zh: 我打電話來詢問將我目前的手機方案升級到包含無限數據和國際漫遊的方案。

sentences.en: The internet connection at my residence has been intermittently dropping for the past three days, severely affecting my ability to work remotely.
sentences.zh: 我家的網路連線在過去三天一直斷斷續續，嚴重影響了我遠端工作的能力。

sentences.en: Could you please explain the difference between your fiber-optic package and the standard broadband plan in terms of speed and reliability?
sentences.zh: 您能否解釋一下你們的光纖套餐和標準寬頻方案在速度和穩定性方面的區別？

sentences.en: I noticed an unexpected charge on my latest bill for a premium service that I never authorized or subscribed to.
sentences.zh: 我注意到最新帳單上有一筆我從未授權或訂閱的高級服務的意外收費。

sentences.en: The technician who visited yesterday said the signal issue was caused by faulty wiring in the junction box outside my building.
sentences.zh: 昨天來訪的技術人員說信號問題是由我大樓外面接線盒的故障線路造成的。

sentences.en: Since my two-year contract is expiring next month, I would like to explore the available options for renewal or switching providers.
sentences.zh: 由於我的兩年合約下個月到期，我想了解續約或更換供應商的可用選項。

sentences.en: The customer service agent assured me that the issue would be resolved within forty-eight hours, yet it remains unaddressed after a full week.
sentences.zh: 客服人員向我保證問題會在四十八小時內解決，但一整週後仍未處理。

sentences.en: I am interested in adding a family plan that would cover four additional lines with shared data and reduced per-line costs.
sentences.zh: 我有興趣增加一個家庭方案，涵蓋四條額外線路並共享數據，且每條線路成本更低。

sentences.en: Could you check whether the slow download speeds I am experiencing are due to network congestion or an issue with my modem?
sentences.zh: 您能否檢查我遇到的下載速度慢是由於網路壅塞還是我的數據機有問題？

sentences.en: The promotional rate I was offered when signing up has apparently expired, resulting in a significant increase in my monthly charges.
sentences.zh: 我註冊時獲得的促銷費率顯然已經過期，導致我的月費大幅增加。

sentences.en: I need to transfer my existing phone number to a new carrier without losing service during the transition period.
sentences.zh: 我需要將現有電話號碼轉移到新的電信商，且在過渡期間不中斷服務。

sentences.en: The router provided by your company appears to be outdated and incapable of supporting the speeds included in my current subscription.
sentences.zh: 貴公司提供的路由器似乎已過時，無法支援我目前訂閱方案所包含的速度。

sentences.en: Having experienced multiple service outages this quarter, I am requesting a credit on my account to compensate for the disruptions.
sentences.zh: 由於本季度經歷了多次服務中斷，我要求在我的帳戶上獲得補償中斷的折扣。

sentences.en: Is there an early termination fee associated with cancelling my contract before the agreed-upon end date listed in my agreement?
sentences.zh: 在我的合約到期日之前取消合約是否有提前終止費？

sentences.en: The 5G coverage map on your website indicates my area is covered, but my device consistently fails to connect to the 5G network.
sentences.zh: 你們網站上的5G覆蓋地圖顯示我的區域有覆蓋，但我的設備一直無法連接到5G網路。

sentences.en: I would like to activate the international calling add-on for the duration of my business trip, which lasts approximately two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我想在我的出差期間啟用國際通話附加功能，出差大約持續兩週。

sentences.en: The automated system keeps disconnecting my call before I can reach a human representative, which is extremely frustrating.
sentences.zh: 自動系統一直在我聯繫到人工代表之前就斷開我的電話，這非常令人沮喪。

sentences.en: According to my usage report, I have consumed less than half of my allotted data this month, yet I received a throttling notification.
sentences.zh: 根據我的使用報告，這個月我使用了不到一半的配額數據，但卻收到了降速通知。

sentences.en: The installation appointment for my new fiber connection was scheduled for last Tuesday, but no technician showed up or called to reschedule.
sentences.zh: 我新光纖連線的安裝預約定在上週二，但沒有技術人員出現或打電話重新安排。

sentences.en: I am concerned about the security of my account after receiving a suspicious text message claiming to be from your company.
sentences.zh: 在收到一條聲稱來自貴公司的可疑簡訊後，我很擔心我帳戶的安全。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to temporarily suspend my service while I am abroad for three months, rather than paying the full monthly rate?
sentences.zh: 在我出國三個月期間，是否可以暫停我的服務，而不是支付全額月費？

sentences.en: The bundle package, which combines internet, cable television, and a phone line, seems more cost-effective than subscribing to each service separately.
sentences.zh: 包含網路、有線電視和電話線的組合套餐似乎比分別訂閱每項服務更划算。

sentences.en: My voicemail system has not been functioning properly since the last network maintenance that was performed over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 自從上週末進行的網路維護以來，我的語音信箱系統一直無法正常運作。

sentences.en: I specifically requested a technician visit between nine and noon, but the confirmation email states an afternoon window instead.
sentences.zh: 我特別要求技術人員在上午九點到中午之間來訪，但確認郵件卻顯示下午的時段。

sentences.en: The data cap on my current plan is insufficient for my household's needs, given that four people regularly stream video content simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 考慮到四個人經常同時串流影片內容，我目前方案的數據上限不足以滿足我家的需求。

sentences.en: I have been a subscriber for over eight years and feel that my loyalty should be rewarded with better rates or additional perks.
sentences.zh: 我已經是用戶超過八年了，覺得我的忠誠度應該用更好的費率或額外福利來獎勵。

sentences.en: The parental controls feature, which I activated to restrict content for my children, does not appear to be filtering websites correctly.
sentences.zh: 我為了限制孩子瀏覽的內容而啟用的家長控制功能，似乎沒有正確過濾網站。

sentences.en: Could you provide me with an itemized breakdown of all the charges on my bill, including taxes and any applicable surcharges?
sentences.zh: 您能提供我帳單上所有收費的逐項明細嗎，包括稅金和任何適用的附加費？

sentences.en: After the recent firmware update pushed to my router, the Wi-Fi range has decreased noticeably and several devices keep disconnecting.
sentences.zh: 在最近推送到我路由器的韌體更新後，Wi-Fi範圍明顯縮小，幾台設備一直斷線。

sentences.en: I am requesting that a supervisor review my case, as the previous representatives were unable to resolve the recurring billing discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 我要求主管審查我的案件，因為之前的客服代表無法解決反覆出現的帳單差異。
